title: NBCFDC General Loan Scheme
ministry: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
briefDescription: A general loan scheme by the Ministry of Social Justice for Indian citizens from backward classes for various income-generating activities. Loan up to ₹15 Lakh per beneficiary for pursuing income-generating activities.

title: Scheme for Dronacharya Award for Outstanding Coaches in Sports and Games
briefDescription: The award for Outstanding Coaches in Sports & Games is a prestigious national sports award instituted by the Government of India to recognize coaches who have consistently demonstrated outstanding & meritorious work in training sportspersons to achieve excellence at international competitions.

title: Scheme For Adolescent Girls
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
briefDescription: The scheme aims to address malnutrition among adolescent girls through nutritional and non-nutritional support. Through this scheme, nutritional support, health services, nutrition education and skilling support are provided to adolescent girls aged 14-18 years in identified areas.

title: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom:Small Cardamom Irrigation Land Development : Rain water harvesting structure (nos)
briefDescription: Under this scheme to motivate the growers to bring more area under irrigation and land development by constructing rain water harvesting structures for increasing the productivity and improving quality of small cardamom.

title: Labour Welfare Scheme (Health)
briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide comprehensive health care and financial assistance for medical treatments. It offers hospital services, medical reimbursements, and subsistence allowances for beedi, cine, and non-coal mine workers and their dependants.

title: Manohar Parrikar Goa Scholars Scheme
briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote postgraduate and Doctor of Philosophy studies among talented students from Goa, encourage admission to reputed institutions in India and abroad, and foster quality education, research, development, and innovation.

title: Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS) 2022- for Thrust Sectors: Scheme For Vaccine Manufacturing Units
state: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
briefDescription: “ Scheme For Vaccine Manufacturing Units'' under the “Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS) - 2022” for Thrust Sectors, implemented by the Dept. of Industries, U.T. Administration Of DNH & DD, aims to provide Credit Linked Interest Subsidy & Capital Subsidy to Vaccine Manufacturing Units.

title: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Post-Harvest Improvement: Polisher for Small Cardamom, Large Cardamom, Turmeric, etc (nos)
briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage spice growers to adopt proper polishing methods for spices such as small cardamom, large cardamom, and turmeric to improve their appearance, quality, and marketability.

title: National Disabled Finance and Development Corporation
briefDescription: The objective of this scheme is to make Persons with Disabilities self-reliant by providing loan facilities through the Himachal Pradesh Minority Finance and Development Corporation (Channelizing Agency) within the State for establishing self-employment ventures.

title: Centenaries and Anniversaries Scheme
briefDescription: The scheme aims to identify, support, and commemorate centenaries and special anniversaries of eminent personalities and events of historical and national importance under approved Commemorations.

title: National Programme for Rehabilitation of Persons with Disablities
briefDescription: The objective of this scheme is to implement various rehabilitation programs for persons with disabilities through the Community-Based Rehabilitation Worker (CBRW) network and to support their rehabilitation by providing assistive devices.

title: To Opt Composition Scheme
briefDescription: The scheme aims to enable eligible GST taxpayers to opt for the Composition Scheme for simplified tax compliance and payment under the Goods and Services Tax (GST) regime.

title: Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme for OBC Students-Delhi
briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to school-going students belonging to Other Backward Classes (OBC) families with an annual income not exceeding ₹2,50,000/- to support their pre-matric education.

title: Scheme of Human Resources Development in Sports- Exchange of Knowledge / Research / Ideas for Attending Seminars, Workshops and Conferences of Repute in India or Abroad
briefDescription: The scheme aims to enhance professional knowledge and skills in sports. Financial assistance is provided to eligible professionals for participating in reputed seminars, workshops and conferences.

title: Scheme of Human Resources Development in Sports- Assistance to Match Officials, Coaches and Support Personnel
briefDescription: The scheme aims to develop specialists, coaches, officials, and researchers in sports. Under this scheme, fellowships, training support, research grants, and publication assistance are provided to sports personnel and institutions.

title: Scheme of Human Resources Development in Sports- Fellowship Programme
briefDescription: The scheme aims to develop specialists, coaches, officials, and researchers in sports. Under this scheme, fellowships, training support, research grants, and publication assistance are provided to sports personnel and institutions.

title: Mobility Scheme
briefDescription: The Mobility Scheme is aimed to provide an opportunity to women scientists who are facing difficulties in their present job due to relocation (marriage, transfer of husband to any other location within the country, attending ailing parents, and accompanying children studying in different city).

title: WISE Post-Doctoral Fellowship
briefDescription: “WISE Post-Doctoral Fellowship” is a new programme of the Department of Science & Technology that aims to provide opportunities to women scientists & technologists between the age group of 27-60 years who want to continue their research as bench-level scientists in basic and applied sciences.

title: Death Benefit
briefDescription: The "Death Benefit'' scheme by the BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, West Bengal, is a welfare scheme that provides financial assistance to the nominee(s) of the beneficiary as death benefit.

title: Atal Pension Yojana
briefDescription: Atal Pension Yojana (APY) is an old age income security scheme for a  savings account holder  in the age group of 18-40 years,  who is not an income tax-payee. It helps to address longevity risks among  workers in unorganized sector and encourages the workers to voluntarily save for retirement.

title: Pragati Scholarship Scheme For Girl Students (Technical Diploma)
briefDescription: A scholarship scheme by AICTE for Girl Students admitted in 1st or 2nd Year of the technical diploma course in an AICTE approved institution. The benefits are provided for a period of max. of 3 years for first-year students and a max. of 2 years for second-year admitted students (later entry).

title: National Youth Corps
briefDescription: A volunteership scheme by Ministry of Youth Affairs And Sports to tap the potential of the disciplined and dedicated youth In the age group of 18 to 29 years who have the inclination and spirit to engage in nation building exercises, to serve up to two years in Nation Building activities.

title: SVAMITVA Yojana (Survey of Villages and Mapping with Improvised Technology in Village Areas)
briefDescription: SVAMITVA, a Central Sector scheme of Ministry of Panchayati Raj to provide ‘Record of Rights’ to village household owners with issuance of legal ownership cards (Property cards/Title deeds) to the property owners by mapping of land parcels using drone technology.

title: Health Minister’s Discretionary Grant
briefDescription: A health scheme by Ministry of Health & Family Welfare for financially poor patients to defray a part of the expenditure on Hospitalization/treatment in Government Hospitals,for life threatening diseases covered under Rashtriya Arogya Nidhi (RAN), in cases where free medical facilities aren't there.

title: National Scheme Of Welfare Of Fishermen
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries,Animal Husbandry and Dairying
briefDescription: The National Scheme of Welfare of Fishermen provides financial assistance to fishermen. They can use these for constructing houses and community halls for both recreation and work purposes. Further, through the amount availed under this scheme, fishermen can install tube wells.

title: Swami Vivekananda Single Girl Child Fellowship for Research in Social Sciences
briefDescription: A fellowship scheme by the University Grants Commission (UGC) for Single Girl Child for research in Social Sciences with an aim to compensate for direct costs of higher education, especially for such girls who happen to be the only girl child in their family.

title: Integrated Social Security Scheme - Women In Distress
briefDescription: ISSS (Integrated Social Security Scheme) is a State Sponsored Scheme by the Social Welfare Department of the Govt. of Jammu and Kashmir where financial assistance is provided to Old Age Persons, Widows, Divorcees, Women in Distress, Transgenders, and Physically Handicapped Persons.

title: Krishonnati Yojana - Sub Mission On Seed And Planting Material (SMSP)
ministry: Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
briefDescription: The Sub-Mission on Seeds and Planting Material (SMSP) aims to increase the production of certified / quality seed, increase SRR, upgrade the quality of farm-saved seeds, strengthen the seed multiplication chain, promote new technologies and methodologies in seed production, processing, testing, etc.

title: Integrated Social Security Scheme - Pension For Physically Challenged Persons
briefDescription: ISSS-PPCP is a State Sponsored Scheme by the Social Welfare Dept. of the Govt. of J&K wherein financial assistance is provided to Physically Challenged Person who have meager support or no source of livelihood. A pension of ₹1000 per pensioner per month is deposited into their bank account.

title: Savitribai Phule Scholarship For V.J.N.T. And S.B.C. Girl Students Studying In 5th To 7th Standard
briefDescription: Savitribai Phule Scholarship is a Scholarship Scheme by the Social Justice and Special Assistance Dept., Govt. of Maharashtra, to encourage the enrollment and to decrease the dropout ratio of Girl Students of Maharashtra from Vimukta Jati and Nomadic Tribes and Special Backward Classes.

title: Chief Minister Samagra Gramya Unnayan Yojana
briefDescription: A 5-year mega-mission called Chief Minister Samagra Gramya Unnayan Yojana (CMSGUY) was launched in the Financial Year(FY) 2016-17, which is scheduled to culminate in the FY 2021-22, coinciding with 75 years of India's Independence.

title: Mukhyamantri Baristha Bunakar and Karigara Sahayata Yojana
briefDescription: Mukhyamantri Baristha Bunakar and Karigara Sahayata Yojana is a welfare scheme initiated by the Handlooms, Textiles and Handicrafts Department, Government of Odisha to provide financial assistance to elderly individuals involved in weaving and craft work, who may face economic difficulties.

title: Mukhyamantri Bayan Jyoti Yojana
briefDescription: The Scheme will be implemented "Mukhyarrantri Bayan Jyoti Yojana" (MBJY) under Chief Minister's Special Package for Handloom weavers.

title: Pension To The Disabled Person
briefDescription: The objective of the pension to the disabled person scheme is providing a pension to disabled persons is multifaceted, but generally centers around promoting social welfare, equity, and inclusivity.

title: Scholarship For Cadets Of Rashtriya Indian Military College (RIMC), Dehradun
briefDescription: The objective of the Scheme is to provide financial assistance to Mizo students permanently residing in the States of studying at RIMC, Dehradun, to enable them to qualify and joint National Defence Academy and further to the Armed Forces. The scheme is 100% funding from the State Plan Fund

title: Bidya Lakshmi Loan
briefDescription: "Bidya Lakshmi" aims to provide education loans for higher studies to children of Assam State Government employees. Benefits include loans up to ₹10,00,000/- at 4% interest, with subsidies for eligible candidates.

title: Financial Assistance To Poor & Needy Widow Women
briefDescription: "Financial Assistance to Poor & Needy Widow Women" is a scheme by the Department of Social Welfare, Govt. of Manipur. The objective of the scheme is to provide social security by way of financial assistance to widows in the age group of 18-40 years.

title: Tailoring Training To Scheduled Caste & Backward Classes Widows/Destitute Women/Girls
briefDescription: The aim of the scheme is to enable Scheduled Caste Widows/girls/destitute women for self-employment. A stipend of Rs.600/- P.M. and raw material costing Rs.300/- per month per trainee is given to a trainee for getting training from the nearest Kalyan Kendar run by this department.

title: Chief Ministergi Shotharabasingi Tengbang (CMST): Scholarship Of Students With Disabilities
briefDescription: "CMST: Scholarship of Students with Disabilities" is a Scholarship Scheme by the Govt. of Manipur. In this scheme, the Students with Disability who are a domicile of the State of Manipur, and are studying in Class 1st and and above are awarded with scholarship of upto ₹ 8,000/-.

title: Arunachal Pradesh State Stipend Scheme
briefDescription: Under this scheme, provide financial support to scheduled tribe (ST) students pursuing higher and technical education through stipends and book grants.

title: Pension to Widows and Destitute Women
briefDescription: Under this scheme, widows and destitute women aged 18 years and above are eligible for a pension if they are domiciles of Haryana and have been residing in the state for at least one year at the time of application submission.

title: Nirman Shramik Antrashtriya Khel Pratiyogiyo Hetu Protsahan Yojana
briefDescription: The purpose of the Nirman Shramik Antrashtriya Khel Pratiyogiyo Hetu Protsahan Yojana is to encourage people employed in Labour Department building, other construction works to participate in international sports by providing them incentives for participating and excelling in international sports.

title: Niramaya Scheme
briefDescription: The Department of Health & Family Welfare Department, Government of Odisha introduced a scheme named "NIRAMAYA" - a Free Medicines Distribution Scheme. The aim is to provide quality essential medicines for all kinds of diseases to patients visiting government health facilities at free of cost.

title: Assistance Scheme For Reimbursement For Expenditure On Visa By Construction Workers For Employment Abroad
briefDescription: This scheme will be called "Reimbursement of expenditure incurred on visa for employment abroad to construction workers". The purpose of this scheme is to provide assistance to the registered beneficiaries employed in building and other construction works for better employment opportunities.

title: Self Employment Scheme
briefDescription: Under this scheme, Subsidies will be provided to the religious minority communities with the help of Nationalized / Scheduled banks to start or improve a small-scale handicraft industry, service sector,  and agro-based activities.

title: Incentive For The Simple Marriage
briefDescription: The Social Welfare Department of the Government of Karnataka has launched the Simple Marriage scheme, which offers incentives to couples belonging to the SC community. The scheme aims to promote the idea of simple marriages and provide financial assistance to eligible couples.

title: Sikkim Unmarried Women Pension Scheme
briefDescription: The scheme “Sikkim Unmarried Women Pension Scheme (SUWPS)” was launched in 2013 by the Department of Women & Child Welfare, Govt. of Sikkim. Under this scheme, the unmarried women of Below Poverty Line (BPL) families in Sikkim would receive a pension of ₹ 2000/- per month.

title: Krushi Mahotsav
briefDescription: The Krishi Mahotsav Yojana is an agricultural development scheme launched by the Government of Gujarat in the year 2010. The scheme aims to boost agricultural productivity and increase the income of farmers in the state.

title: Atal Sneh Yojana
briefDescription: Gujarat Chief Minister Shri Vijay Rupani here today announced the Atal ‘Screening of Newborn for Enhancement of Health’ (SNEH) Yojna to be started in the state from the former Prime Minister Atal Behari Vajpayee’s birthday on December 25, 2016.

title: Nirman Shramik Safety Kit Yojana
briefDescription: "Nirman Shramik Safety Kit Yojana" is a scheme by the Department of Labour, Employment, Training & Skill Development Govt of Jharkhand. The scheme provides a direct cash transfer of ₹ 1,000/- for purchasing a branded helmet and a pair of safety shoes.

title: Sardar Patel Awas Yojana
briefDescription: Sardar Patel Awas Yojana (SPAY) is a housing scheme launched by the government of Gujarat in India to provide affordable housing to economically weaker sections (EWS) and low-income groups (LIG) of society.

title: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme - Sikkim
briefDescription: The scheme “Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)” by the Department of Women & Child Welfare, Govt. of Sikkim provides financial support is provided to the poor widows of the state of Sikkim. The beneficiary receives a monthly pension of ₹ 2000/- through DBT.

title: Chief Ministergi Artistesinggi Tengbang (CMAT) – Artiste’s Pension
briefDescription: The scheme "Chief Ministergi Artistesinggi Tengbang (CMAT) – Artiste’s Pension" by the Dept. of Art and Culture, Govt. of Manipur provides a monthly pension of up to ₹ 4,000/- to the aged reputed artists who have contributed to making the tradition, culture, and art forms of Manipur more vibrant.

title: Financial Assistance To Disabled For Self Employment
briefDescription: The objective of this scheme is to facilitate the self-employment of unemployed disabled persons. Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided to persons with disabilities for self-employment, small-scale business, and agro-based project. This scheme is 100% funded by Govt. of Maharashtra.

title: Nirman Shramik Pucca Ghar Yojana
briefDescription: Labour and ESI Department, Government of Odisha has introduced a scheme "Nirman Shramik Pucca Ghar Yojana (NSPGY)" to meet the housing needs of the building and other construction workers in rural areas, registered under the Odisha Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (OB&OCWWB).

title: Special Education And Vocational Training Through Government Institutions
briefDescription: In this scheme, Special Education is provided to children with disability between the age group of 6 to 18 years in the Government Special Schools and Vocational Training is provided to special children above the age of 18 years. Only citizens who are permanent residents of Maharashtra are eligible.

title: Financial Assistance For Aids And Appliances For Disabled Persons
briefDescription: The "Financial Assistance for Aids and Appliances for Disabled Persons" is a scheme by the Govt. of Maharashtra. The objective of this scheme is to provide assistance to Persons with Disabilities (PwDs) for the purchase of aids and appliances as per their age group and the type of disability.

title: Odisha State Treatment Fund
briefDescription: The Odisha State Treatment Fund will provide financial assistance for treatment of the poor patients suffering from life threatening disorders & diseases. The financial assistance will be released to the Medical Institutions where the patient undergoes treatment.

title: The Post-Matric Scholarship For Scheduled Tribes Students
briefDescription: The scheme "Post-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Tribes Students" by the Ministry of Tribal Affairs, Government of India, and Government of Mizoram aims to provide financial assistance to ST students pursuing post-matriculation education. It covers various recognized courses.

title: Widow/Abandoned/Single Woman Pension Scheme
briefDescription: Widow/Abandoned/Single Woman Pension Scheme of Himachal Pradesh Government aims to provide financial help to widows, abandoned women, and unmarried women shall be entitled to receive pension for a sum of Rs.1,150/-per month.

title: Unemployment Allowance
briefDescription: Chhattisgarh Berozgari Bhatta Yojana is an important initiative of Chhattisgarh Government for the unemployed. It has been announced by the Chief Minister of the state Mr. Bhupesh Baghel in his budget speech on 06-03-2023.

title: Mukhyamantri Kisan Sahay Yojana
briefDescription: The scheme was launched on September 6, 2019, to provide relief and support to farmers in case of crop damage due to natural calamities and was implemented by the Revenue Department of the Government of Gujarat in collaboration with the Agriculture and Co-operation Department.

title: Chief Minister’s Yuva Kaushal Yojana
briefDescription: The scheme “Chief Minister’s Yuva Kaushal Yojana (CM YKY)” was launched by the government of Arunachal Pradesh on 1st April 2018 to provide high-end training to the youth across the state to enable them to find jobs in the private sector.

title: Cluster Nutritional Kitchen Garden Scheme
briefDescription: The Cluster Nutritional Kitchen Garden Scheme (CNKGS) is an initiative launched by the government of Arunachal Pradesh to promote self-sufficiency and improve nutritional needs by encouraging the establishment of kitchen gardens.

title: Advance For Purchase Or Construction Of House (APB&OCWWB)
briefDescription: The scheme “Advance for Purchase or Construction of House” was started by the Department of Labour and Employment, Govt. of Arunachal Pradesh for the registered workers of Arunachal Pradesh Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (APB&OCWWB).

title: Mukhyamantri Vriksharopan Protsahan Yojana
briefDescription: Chhattisgarh Mukhyamantri Vriksharopan Protsahan Yojana has been started by the Government of Chhattisgarh with the aim of conserving the environment and doubling the income of the farmers by promoting tree plantation in the state.

title: Arun Pig Development Scheme
briefDescription: The scheme “Arun Pig Development Scheme” was launched by the Department of Animal Husbandry, Veterinary & Dairy Development, Government of Arunachal Pradesh in the financial year 2019-20 with a focus on pig rearing.

title: Schemes Of HP Minorities Finance & Development Corporation
briefDescription: Social, educational and economic upliftment of the minority class people living below the poverty line of the state.

title: ₹ 5 Lakh Insurance Cover To Farmers
briefDescription: Launched on 15 August 2018, the scheme "₹5 Lakh Insurance Cover for Farmers" is an Insurance Scheme by the Department of Agriculture, Government of Telangana. This scheme provides ₹5 lakh insurance coverage to all farmers aged between 18 and 60 years.

title: Financial Assistance To The Child Victims Of Violence Under TheNational Foundation For Communal Harmony

briefDescription: Under the scheme, an additional amount of ₹100/- per month, in addition to the pension amount, is provided to the widow of an ex-serviceman who dies while in service but not in any battle.

title: Term Loan Scheme for Backward Classes
briefDescription: The scheme is implemented by the Haryana Backward Classes & Economically Weaker Sections Kalyan Nigam. Under this scheme, loans of up to ₹15,00,000/- are provided at an annual interest rate of 6% to 8% to individuals from the Backward Classes to enhance their employability.

title: Gayathri Scheme for Academic Excellence
briefDescription: The "Gayathri Scheme for Academic Excellence" scheme aims to provide awards to the topper of the recognized and reputed School/ College/ Institute for his/her academic excellence in SSC/ Intermediate or equivalent/ Graduation/ Professional Education Course for the Academic year.

title: Tool Purchase Grant for the Construction Workers
briefDescription: “Tool Purchase Grant for the Construction Workers” scheme by the BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Dep.t, West Bengal, is a welfare scheme that provides one time reimbursement to each registered beneficiary who is with the Board for a period of at least 6 months for purchasing tools for his profession.

title: Miscarriage Benefit
briefDescription: The "Miscarriage Benefit'' scheme by the BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department,West Bengal, is a welfare scheme that provides financial benefits for miscarriage up to two times in a lifetime to the eligible female beneficiaries or the wives of male beneficiaries.

title: Financial Assistance for Education of Self/ Children of Beneficiaries
briefDescription: The "Financial Assistance for Education of Self/ Children of Beneficiaries'' scheme by the BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, West Bengal, is a welfare scheme that provides financial assistance to the registered member or their children studying Higher Secondary and above.

title: Integrated Social Security Scheme: Pension to Physically Challenged Persons
briefDescription: Under this scheme, a monthly pension of ₹1,000/- is provided to poor physically handicapped persons (including those who are blind, deaf, or dumb) with a degree of disability 40% or above and having no source of income.

title: Scholarship for Fatherless Girls
briefDescription: The objective of this scheme is to support the education of girls who have lost their fathers and are studying in government schools. Under this scheme, scholarships ranging from ₹350/- to ₹450/- are provided to eligible girls from Class 1 to Class 12.

title: Digital J&K Internship Scheme
briefDescription: The "Digital J&K Internship Scheme" is an opportunity for the students to secure first-hand and practical work experience. It also aims at active participation in the learning process through experimentation and putting into practice the knowledge acquired in the studies.

title: Cost of Spectacle for the Construction Workers
briefDescription: The “Cost of Spectacle for the Construction Workers” scheme by the BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department,West Bengal, is a welfare scheme that provides reimbursement for purchasing spectacle to each registered beneficiary if required.

title: Cost of Hearing Aid for the Construction Workers
briefDescription: The “Cost of Hearing Aid for the Construction Workers” scheme by the BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department,West Bengal, is a welfare scheme that provides reimbursement for purchasing Hearing Aids to each registered beneficiary if required.

title: Accidental Benefit
briefDescription: The "Accidental Benefit'' scheme by the BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department,West Bengal, is a welfare scheme that provides financial assistance to the beneficiary in case of hospitalization and disability due to an accident.

title: Maternity Benefit
briefDescription: The "Maternity Benefit'' scheme by the BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department,West Bengal, is a welfare scheme that provides maternity benefits up to two times in a lifetime to the eligible female beneficiaries or the wives of male beneficiaries.

title: Pension Benefit
briefDescription: The "Pension Benefit'' scheme by the BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department,West Bengal, is a welfare scheme that provides a monthly pension after completion of 60 years to the eligible registered member.

title: Mukhya Mantri Mahila Sashaktikaran Yojana
briefDescription: Under this scheme, permanent training will be provided for the economic and social upliftment of women suffering from any form of violence and living in difficult circumstances so that they can get employment.

title: Bhraman - Darshan Yojana
briefDescription: The "Bhraman-Darshan Yojana" was launched by the Animal and Fisheries Resources Department, Government of Bihar aims to educate fish farmers in Bihar about the latest fisheries techniques through organized excursions, enabling them to adopt and implement these technologies in their water source.....

title: Mukhyamantri Vidwa Evam Ekal Naari Awas Yojana
briefDescription: The "Mukhyamantri Vidwa Evam Ekal Naari Awas Yojana" was launched by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of Himachal Pradesh. The scheme aims to provide financial grants for the construction of houses to economically weak widows and single women.

title: Financial Assistance to WW II Veteran and Widows of WW II Veterans
briefDescription: Under the scheme, financial assistance of ₹10,000/- per month shall be given to Ex-servicemen of the Pre-Independence Era (World War II Veterans) & their widows, who are not in receipt of any kind of pension/financial assistance either from any Department of Government of India/State Government.
